name: minecraft-redstone
description: Build and debug vanilla redstone with compact game data, backed-up construction plans and tick traces.

interface.shortDescription: Build and inspect Minecraft with Codex.
interface.longDescription: Minecraft Java26.3 bridge fork with compact structured observation, inventory views, construction previews/backups/undo, named buses and finite tick recordings. Separate spectator-client control preserves user input. Runtime acceptance and a separate rendered observer still require game setup. Local Node.js22+ and Java25 required.
